(Japanese: '''ポケSPedia''' ''PokéSPedia'') is a special databook made to celebrate the twentieth anniversary of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. 

==Publications==
{{publications/h|Kanto}}
{{publications|cover=PokéSPedia.png|edition=First|country=Japan|company=Shogakukan|date=August 8, 2017|ISBN=4091990487}}
|}

==Information revealed==
* A timeline of the entire series.
* The ages and birthdays of {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|White}}, {{adv|X}}, {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Sun}}, and {{adv|Moon}}.
* The genders, levels, natures, and characteristics for several of the [[Pokédex holder]]s' Pokémon.
* {{adv|Green}} is revealed to have obtained a second {{p|Jigglypuff}} nicknamed Ririri.
* {{adv|Blue}} is revealed to own a {{p|Pumpkaboo}}.
* {{tc|Sailor}} [[Eldritch]] is revealed to have been the same Sailor that worked for [[Lt. Surge]].
* Green is confirmed to have been the creator of the [[Silph Scope]].

==Errors==
* Several of the [[Pokédex holder]]s' Pokémon's levels are listed as 00.
* The [[move]]s of [[Diantha's Gardevoir]] are the same as [[Steven's Metagross]].
* Several of the Pokédex holders' ages are errors.
* Several pieces of information about overseas publications are errors.
